name: SRIT India Limited
description: We are a Bengaluru-headquartered Information Technology and Information Technology enabled Services (IT/ITes) solutions company offering digital solutions and automations of systems through custom application development and integration services. We have a track record of twenty-six years in designing, implementing and operating digital platforms for Government entities and Enterprises in India and select overseas markets. Our Company has successfully implemented large-scale, mission-critical projects for both central and state government bodies across India.
